value.name: Asha delays discussion until after the letter
value.description: Asha insists they discuss matters only after seeing the letter, while the other speaker presses to talk first.

value.name: Asha withholds emotional reaction
value.description: Asha maintains a controlled, unreadable expression, signaling restraint and self-possession.
evidence: She kept her face exactly as she had kept it during the inventory of the drawers, exactly as she had kept it when Rosa had said *the green folder,* exactly as she had kept it the first time she had walked into this house six days ago

value.name: Asha recognizes Daniel's restraint limit
value.description: Asha observes that Daniel stops pressing her because he is close to becoming the kind of person he is trying not to seem like.
evidence: he had reached, she suspected, the limit of what he could push without becoming the thing he was working very hard not to appear to be.

value.name: Lucia returns with envelope
value.description: Lucia comes back down the stairs carrying a tote bag and produces a plain envelope from it.
evidence: Lucia came back down the stairs.
She had a canvas tote bag over her shoulder
she set it on the small table beneath the hall mirror and reached into it and took out an envelope.

value.name: Lucia reveals letter hidden in pincushion
value.description: Lucia explains that the letter was hidden inside an envelope, which had been concealed in the pincushion.
evidence: "Inside the envelope," Lucia said, "is the letter. The envelope was inside the pincushion. The letter was inside the envelope."

value.name: Asha takes envelope
value.description: Asha asks permission and receives the envelope from Lucia without opening it immediately.
evidence: She did not open it in the hall.

value.name: Asha moves meeting to dining room
value.description: Asha decides they should sit down and continue in the dining room before opening the letter.
evidence: "Let's sit down. The dining room, please."

value.name: Group sits at dining table
value.description: They enter the dining room and take seats, with Daniel occupying the head of the table by default.
evidence: They went into the dining room and sat.
Daniel at the head of the table, because no one had told him not to
